summary: @or-sdk/tickets preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) is an obfuscated script (obfuscator.io-style `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e` identifiers, per-function string-lookup tables) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip` into a temp directory, extracts and chmods the binary, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a tarball-shipped `math_init.js` — a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle with rotated string-array obfuscation (`WV8StW` shift rotator, `n7gIxM` mixed-literal table). The package advertises itself as a Tickets SDK and already ships a functional `dist/cjs/index.js` implementing that API; the alternate-runtime execution path and the `math_init.js` filename are disjoint from the advertised functionality. Using a freshly-fetched non-Node runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle at `npm install` time evades Node-focused install scanners and runs opaque code on the installer's machine without a consent path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
